qualifier: nodal and His-Purkinje development with gap-junction coupling
name: Cardiac conduction system development and gap-junction coupling
rationale: All members concern the heart's conduction system (SA node, AV node and His-Purkinje development plus electrical/gap-junction coupling), whereas the confusables cover nodal action-potential depolarization or early cardiomyocyte fate.

qualifier: L1/CHL1, DSCAM and Sidekick adhesion plus netrin
name: Neurite guidance via L1, DSCAM, Sidekick adhesion and netrin
rationale: Members are axon/dendrite guidance and self-avoidance driven by L1-family, DSCAM and SDK adhesion molecules and netrin signaling, distinguishing it from ephrin, semaphorin and nectin-centred guidance/adhesion neighbours.

core: Striated muscle calcium transport and excitability
qualifier: inhibitory control including SERCA and fiber-type switching
name: Inhibition of striated muscle calcium transport and excitability
rationale: Members are negative regulation of plasma-membrane and SR calcium flux, SERCA activity, K+ export and action potentials in muscle (a phospholamban/sarcolipin-like profile), unlike neighbours focused on cardiac action-potential phases, contraction force or Ca2+ release.

qualifier: lysosomal hexosaminidase degradation and lysosomal enzyme secretion
name: Glycosphingolipid metabolism, lysosomal hexosaminidase degradation and enzyme secretion
rationale: Members span ganglioside/glycosphingolipid synthesis, transport and lysosomal (HEXA/HEXB/NEU1, glucosamine-glycoside) degradation plus lysosomal enzyme secretion, unlike the sphingomyelin/ceramide or sialic acid/N-glycan neighbours.

name: Reelin signaling and dendritic spine maintenance
rationale: Members are Reelin signaling with dendrite development, spine maintenance and postsynaptic organization, whereas neighbours lack Reelin and add amyloid-beta, microglial or synaptic-transmission terms.

name: Peroxisome biogenesis, protein import and pexophagy
rationale: Members cover peroxisomal membrane/matrix protein import, fission and autophagic turnover of peroxisomes, while neighbours are peroxisomal fatty acid oxidation and lipid synthesis.

core: Eicosanoid synthesis, receptor signaling and catabolism
name: Leukotriene-centred eicosanoid synthesis, receptor signaling and catabolism
rationale: Members are arachidonate-derived leukotriene, lipoxin and HETE synthesis, their receptors and omega-oxidation catabolism, unlike neighbours centred on P450 epoxygenase products or resolvin/protectin SPMs.

name: Late cholesterol biosynthesis via Bloch and Kandutsch-Russell branches
rationale: All members are post-lanosterol sterol steps (zymosterol, desmosterol, lathosterol routes), distinguishing the theme from upstream mevalonate/lanosterol, bile acid and fatty acid neighbours.

name: Cation-chloride cotransporters and sodium-potassium transport regulation
rationale: Members are SLC12 cotransporters and their Bartter/Gitelman disorders with renal Na+ and K+ transport regulation, unlike neighbours centred on vasopressin water handling, magnesium, Na+/H+ exchange or osmotic responses.

name: RIG-I-like receptor antiviral signaling and its negative regulation
rationale: Members are RIG-I/MDA5 sensing of dsRNA with downstream IRF3/NF-kB activation and its positive and negative regulation, whereas neighbours emphasize interferon production, cGAS-STING or TLR-driven IRF7.

name: CSF1 and GM-CSF signaling in monocyte-macrophage differentiation
rationale: Members are M-CSF/GM-CSF and interleukin receptor signaling driving monocyte, macrophage and myeloid dendritic cell differentiation, unlike neighbours on osteoclast fusion, SIRP/DAP12 signaling or G-CSF granulopoiesis.

qualifier: ganglioside synthesis, glycolipid transport and lysosomal degradation
name: Glycosphingolipid synthesis, transport and lysosomal ganglioside degradation
rationale: Members are glycosphingolipid/ganglioside biosynthesis, glycolipid transfer and lysosomal catabolism (HEXA/HEXB/NEU1), without the Golgi membrane and lysosomal enzyme secretion of the closest neighbour or the sphingomyelin and N-glycan terms of others.

name: Granulocyte lineage differentiation including eosinophils and mast cells
rationale: Members are neutrophil, eosinophil and mast cell differentiation with G-CSF/GM-CSF signaling, whereas neighbours lack eosinophil and mast cell terms and add monocyte or HSC transcriptional programs.

name: Death receptor-induced caspase-8 activation in extrinsic apoptosis
rationale: Members are TRAIL and FasL signaling, procaspase-8 dimerization, c-FLIP control and BID activation, distinct from neighbours on mitochondrial/p53 intrinsic apoptosis or necroptosis.

name: Radial and tangential neuronal migration in brain development
rationale: Members are radial glia-guided and tangential neuron migration with cortical layering and forebrain regional development, unlike neighbours on commissure/tract morphogenesis or spinal cord patterning.

name: G2/M checkpoint recovery and TP53 stability control
rationale: Members are G2/M re-entry (MASTL, GTSE1, Cdc25A degradation) and regulation of TP53 phosphorylation and degradation via COP1, unlike neighbours on G1/S RB-CDK4/6 control or radiation-induced G2 checkpoint signaling.

name: Natriuretic peptide cGMP signaling and renal sodium excretion
rationale: Members are cyclic nucleotide (cGMP/cAMP) responses, receptor guanylyl cyclase signaling and natriuretic factors promoting natriuresis and urine output, whereas neighbours center on renin-angiotensin and vascular pressure control.

name: Growth hormone and IGF signaling in growth and lifespan
rationale: Members are GH receptor/JAK-STAT signaling, GH secretion, IGF responses and their roles in growth rate and lifespan, distinct from neighbours on prolactin, leptin, thyroid hormone or glucagon signaling.

qualifier: TGF-beta1 production and fibroblast proliferation control
name: Stromal fibroblast secretory program and TGF-beta1 production regulation
rationale: Members are fibroblast/perivascular stromal secretory and complement-ECM modules with regulation of TGF-beta1 production, fibroblast proliferation and adhesion, unlike neighbours on collagen-integrin ECM, YAP/TAZ mechanoresponse or endothelial programs.

name: RNA exosome-mediated nuclear RNA decay and 3'-end processing
rationale: Members are 3'-to-5' exosome trimming and surveillance of rRNA, snRNA, snoRNA, tRNA, CUTs and mRNA, distinct from neighbours on snoRNP/Cajal body, pre-rRNA cleavage, NMD/ribosome quality control or splicing.

name: NRF2 and FOXO oxidative-stress transcription and metabolic rewiring
rationale: Members are NFE2L2 and FOXO transcriptional programs with AKT, p53 and mTORC1 control of glycolysis and pentose-phosphate flux, unlike neighbours centred on HIF hypoxia/glycolysis or ER unfolded protein response.

name: Endosome-Golgi retrograde transport and endocytic recycling
rationale: Members are endosome-to-Golgi retrograde transport, Golgi-endosome exchange and receptor/endocytic recycling, whereas neighbours emphasize Golgi organization, COPI vesicles and lysosome vesicle biogenesis.

name: Calcineurin-NFAT signaling in cardiomyocyte hypertrophic growth
rationale: Members are calcineurin-NFAT signaling regulation and cardiac muscle adaptation, cell size and sarcomere growth, unlike neighbours on contractility, atrophy or regeneration.

qualifier: alveolar surfactant and erythrocyte Rh-mediated transport
name: Respiratory gas exchange: alveolar surfactant and erythrocyte Rh transport
rationale: Members combine pulmonary surfactant metabolism and its disorders with erythrocyte O2/CO2/NO exchange and Rh-glycoprotein ammonium transport, separating it from heme/iron, lactate transport and lung developmental neighbours.

qualifier: de novo CDP pathways and cardiolipin remodeling
name: De novo glycerophospholipid synthesis and cardiolipin remodeling
rationale: Members are CDP-choline/CDP-DAG synthesis of PC, PE, PS, PG and cardiolipin plus PG/CL acyl remodeling, unlike neighbours on general acyl-chain remodeling, phospholipid catabolism/transfer or PA/TAG synthesis.
